title: 擠壓性地層讓壓支護~Yielding support in squeezing ground
focus: 把擠壓地層收斂、讓壓行程與支護時序連成設計模型~Link squeezing-ground convergence, yielding travel and support timing
summary: 本課以把擠壓地層收斂、讓壓行程與支護時序連成設計模型為主線，從應力強度比與初篩與收斂拘束與交會點建立系統邊界，再把收斂速率與時效、噴層間隙與局部壓碎連到觀察法與調整證據。擠壓是高應力下的時間相依變形，不能直接等同材料遇水膨脹。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。~This course focuses on link squeezing-ground convergence, yielding travel and support timing. It begins with Stress-strength ratio and screening and Convergence-confinement intersection, links Convergence rate and time dependence and Shotcrete slots and local crushing, and ends with Observational design and adjustment evidence. Squeezing is stress-driven time-dependent deformation and is not identical to water-induced swelling. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.

units.anchor: 應力強度比與初篩~Stress-strength ratio and screening
units.title: 應力強度比與初篩~Stress-strength ratio and screening
units.mechanism: 高覆土應力與低岩體強度的組合可能造成大變形，但垂直應力不代表完整三維應力場。完整岩樣強度也不同於節理岩體強度，將兩者混用會高估地層能力；比值只協助比較調查情境，不能單獨決定讓壓構件和開挖尺寸。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將原位應力方向、岩體分級與試樣強度分別列示；若出現把完整岩樣強度當岩體強度，低估節理控制的大變形，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~High cover stress combined with weak rock mass can produce large deformation, but vertical stress is not the full three-dimensional field. Intact-sample strength differs from jointed-rock strength. The ratio helps compare investigation scenarios but cannot alone determine yielding components or excavation geometry. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Report in-situ stress direction, rock-mass characterization and specimen strength separately. If using intact strength for the rock mass understates joint-controlled deformation, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：sigmaV=gamma*H=26 kN/m3*500 m=13 MPa; ratio=13/3=4.33。擠壓是高應力下的時間相依變形，不能直接等同材料遇水膨脹。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: sigmaV=gamma*H=26 kN/m3*500 m=13 MPa; ratio=13/3=4.33. Squeezing is stress-driven time-dependent deformation and is not identical to water-induced swelling. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.
units.verify: 將原位應力方向、岩體分級與試樣強度分別列示。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「把完整岩樣強度當岩體強度，低估節理控制的大變形」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。~Report in-situ stress direction, rock-mass characterization and specimen strength separately. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Using intact strength for the rock mass understates joint-controlled deformation. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.
units.failure: 把完整岩樣強度當岩體強度，低估節理控制的大變形。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將原位應力方向、岩體分級與試樣強度分別列示，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。~Using intact strength for the rock mass understates joint-controlled deformation. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to report in-situ stress direction, rock-mass characterization and specimen strength separately to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.
units.misconception: 應力強度比一個數字就能完全預測擠壓量~One stress-strength ratio completely predicts squeezing deformation
units.practice: 將將原位應力方向、岩體分級與試樣強度分別列示列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現把完整岩樣強度當岩體強度，低估節理控制的大變形，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。~Apply the following check at handover: Report in-situ stress direction, rock-mass characterization and specimen strength separately. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If using intact strength for the rock mass understates joint-controlled deformation, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

units.anchor: 收斂拘束與交會點~Convergence-confinement intersection
units.title: 收斂拘束與交會點~Convergence-confinement intersection
units.mechanism: 地層反應曲線和支護曲線的交會描述特定假設下的平衡，安裝前收斂決定支護曲線起點。兩條曲線不是材料常數，開挖三維效應和時效會改變位置；比較方案必須固定地層模型，並保留支護介入時已發生的變形。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較安裝時位移零點、後續收斂及支護反力曲線；若出現忽略安裝前變形讓支護反力起算過早，誤判剛度效果，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~The ground-support curve intersection describes equilibrium under specified assumptions, with preinstallation convergence setting the support origin. Neither curve is a universal material constant. Three-dimensional excavation and time shift them, so compare schemes under consistent ground assumptions and retain deformation before support engagement. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare installation displacement zero, subsequent convergence and support reaction curves. If ignoring preinstallation motion starts support loading too early and misjudges stiffness effects, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 讓壓平台與行程需求~Yielding plateau and travel demand
units.title: 讓壓平台與行程需求~Yielding plateau and travel demand
units.mechanism: 讓壓元件在變形中維持反力，目的是避免剛性支護過早超載，同時保留必要拘束。平台力太低可能無法穩住地層，行程太短則很快轉為高剛度；需把力、行程與地層預期收斂一起比較，不能只選最大吸能值。 判別這個機制時，應觀察記錄平台力、實際行程及行程末端的剛度改變；若出現讓壓行程耗盡後反力陡增，導致相鄰噴層壓碎，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~A yielding element maintains restraint while deforming to avoid premature overload of rigid support. Too little force may not stabilize ground; too little travel quickly returns to high stiffness. Compare force and stroke against expected convergence rather than selecting the largest energy rating alone. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Record plateau force, actual travel and stiffness change near the stroke end. If exhausted yielding travel sharply raises reaction and crushes adjacent shotcrete, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

Squeezing is stress-driven time-dependent deformation and is not identical to water-induced swelling. units.anchor: 預留變形與淨空消耗~Deformation allowance and clearance consumption
units.title: 預留變形與淨空消耗~Deformation allowance and clearance consumption
units.mechanism: 預留變形需要在開挖尺寸、支護厚度和永久淨空之間分配，不是任意放大洞徑。實際收斂可能不對稱，圓形平均半徑只會顯示總量而漏掉局部侵限；應用全斷面幾何檢核剩餘空間與後續襯砌需求。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以各時期全斷面掃描比較預留量及永久襯砌輪廓；若出現局部收斂侵入襯砌空間，平均變形量卻仍在範圍內，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Deformation allowance must be allocated among excavation, support and permanent clearance rather than simply enlarging the opening. Convergence can be asymmetric, so a mean radius hides local intrusion. Use complete profiles to assess remaining space and future lining requirements. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare full-section scans with allowances and permanent-lining geometry. If local convergence consumes lining space while mean movement still appears acceptable, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 收斂速率與時效~Convergence rate and time dependence
units.title: 收斂速率與時效~Convergence rate and time dependence
units.mechanism: 擠壓地層可能在掌子面遠離後繼續變形，速率曲線有助區分短期卸載和持續蠕變。不同量測間隔會把尖峰平均掉，施工停頓也改變時間基準；比較需同時保留距面距離和真實經過時間，不應只按進尺排序。 判別這個機制時，應觀察用固定時間尺度與距面位置共同比較收斂速率；若出現長停機期間的變形被漏記，使後續支護需求低估，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Squeezing can continue after the face has moved away, and rates help distinguish immediate unloading from continuing creep. Sampling intervals average peaks, while stoppages change elapsed time. Preserve both distance from the face and real time rather than ordering observations solely by advance. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare convergence rates on consistent time intervals and face-relative positions. If unrecorded deformation during a long stoppage understates later support demand, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：rate=(45-30) mm/(6-3) day=5 mm/day。擠壓是高應力下的時間相依變形，不能直接等同材料遇水膨脹。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: rate=(45-30) mm/(6-3) day=5 mm/day. Squeezing is stress-driven time-dependent deformation and is not identical to water-induced swelling. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

units.anchor: 拱架滑移接頭~Sliding joints in steel ribs
units.title: 拱架滑移接頭~Sliding joints in steel ribs
units.mechanism: 滑移接頭需在可控制反力下產生相對位移，摩擦和夾緊狀態決定啟動及持續力。各接頭若不均勻動作，整榀拱形可能偏轉，因而不能只確認某一接頭可以滑；應檢查整榀行程分配與噴層間隙相容。 判別這個機制時，應觀察逐接頭量測滑移、夾緊狀態與拱架輪廓變化；若出現單側接頭卡住使其餘位置超滑，拱頂偏心受力，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Sliding joints must move under controlled resistance governed by friction and clamping. Uneven activation distorts the rib, so one functioning joint does not establish system behaviour. Check the distribution of travel around the rib and compatibility with gaps in the sprayed layer. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Measure slip and clamping at every joint together with rib-profile change. If one jammed joint forces excessive slip elsewhere and shifts crown loading, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

units.anchor: 噴層間隙與局部壓碎~Shotcrete slots and local crushing
units.title: 噴層間隙與局部壓碎~Shotcrete slots and local crushing
units.mechanism: 讓壓間隙允許環向縮短，但間隙端部會產生應力集中，填入不相容材料可能提早鎖死。開縫長度也不能簡單視為均勻應變，因為周圍噴層仍有彎曲與接觸；應把間隙閉合過程和鋼拱滑移一同追蹤。 判別這個機制時，應觀察量測各間隙剩餘寬度、端部裂紋及鄰近鋼拱滑移；若出現砂漿誤填讓壓間隙使反力突然增加並壓碎端部，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Yield slots allow circumferential shortening but concentrate stress at their ends. Incompatible infill can lock them early. Slot closure is not uniform lining strain because adjacent shotcrete still bends and contacts ground; track it alongside steel-rib sliding rather than as an isolated gap. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Measure remaining slots, end cracks and nearby steel-rib slip. If accidental mortar filling locks a yielding slot and crushes its ends, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 反算參數與可辨識性~Back-analysis and identifiability
units.title: 反算參數與可辨識性~Back-analysis and identifiability
units.mechanism: 一條收斂曲線可能由不同地層強度、模數或支護安裝時間組合產生，擬合良好不代表參數唯一。增加支護反力、孔內位移或獨立地質證據才能限制解的範圍；反算應呈現多組可能情境，而非只交一條最漂亮曲線。 判別這個機制時，應觀察用保留的獨立量測區段檢驗反算參數的外推能力；若出現多參數互相補償得到良好擬合，遇新地層立即失準，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Different ground strengths, moduli and installation times can reproduce one convergence curve, so fit quality does not imply uniqueness. Support reactions, borehole movement and independent geology constrain the solution. Report plausible alternatives rather than only the best-looking fitted curve. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Test back-calculated parameters against withheld independent monitoring sections. If compensating parameters produce a good fit but fail immediately in different ground, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

units.anchor: 長期荷載與二次襯砌~Long-term load and secondary lining
units.title: 長期荷載與二次襯砌~Long-term load and secondary lining
units.mechanism: 二次襯砌完成後地層仍可能蠕變，初支和永久結構的分擔取決於接觸、剛度與施工時間。不能因外觀停止變形就假定永久荷載不再增加，儀器解析度也可能掩蓋慢速變化；設計應保留長期監測和可解釋的力學模型。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較長期收斂、接觸水壓及二次襯砌應變的趨勢；若出現短期穩定被當成永久穩定，慢速蠕變逐年消耗淨空，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Ground may creep after secondary lining, with load sharing governed by contact, stiffness and timing. Apparently stopped movement does not prove constant permanent demand, and resolution can hide slow trends. Preserve long-term monitoring and an interpretable mechanical model for later comparisons. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare long-term convergence, contact water pressure and secondary-lining strain trends. If short-term stability is treated as permanent while slow creep consumes clearance over years, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 觀察法與調整證據~Observational design and adjustment evidence
units.title: 觀察法與調整證據~Observational design and adjustment evidence
units.mechanism: 觀察法需要事前定義可觀察量、可接受範圍及對應備案，並非看到問題後任意修改。讓壓行程、收斂速率和支護損傷反映不同邊界，調整前必須確認量測有效；版本追蹤可避免不同班組使用互相矛盾的支護假設。 判別這個機制時，應觀察逐項核對觸發依據、儀器有效性、設計版本及核定責任；若出現失效感測器觸發錯誤支護調整，卻沒有留下決策依據，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Observational design requires predefined observables, acceptable ranges and contingency actions rather than arbitrary changes after trouble. Stroke, convergence rate and damage reveal different boundaries; confirm measurement validity before adjustment. Revision control prevents crews from using contradictory support assumptions. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Audit trigger evidence, instrument validity, design revision and approval responsibility. If a failed sensor prompts an incorrect support change without a recorded rationale, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

example: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查應力強度比與初篩：sigmaV=gamma*H=26 kN/m3*500 m=13 MPa; ratio=13/3=4.33；再獨立檢查收斂拘束與交會點：supportPressure=k*(u-u0)=20 MPa/m*(0.08-0.03) m=1.0 MPa。覆土由 500 增為 600 m、單位重 26 kN/m3，垂直應力由 13 增為 15.6 MPa；對 3 MPa 岩體強度的比由 4.33 變為 5.2，只作初篩。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為擠壓是高應力下的時間相依變形，不能直接等同材料遇水膨脹。 將用保留的獨立量測區段檢驗反算參數的外推能力作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。~All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Stress-strength ratio and screening: sigmaV=gamma*H=26 kN/m3*500 m=13 MPa; ratio=13/3=4.33. Independently check Convergence-confinement intersection: supportPressure=k*(u-u0)=20 MPa/m*(0.08-0.03) m=1.0 MPa. At 26 kN/m3, cover rising from 500 to 600 m raises vertical stress from 13 to 15.6 MPa and its ratio to 3 MPa rock-mass strength from 4.33 to 5.2, for screening only. The two results are not a complete design because squeezing is stress-driven time-dependent deformation and is not identical to water-induced swelling. Use test back-calculated parameters against withheld independent monitoring sections as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
history: 本課討論的把擠壓地層收斂、讓壓行程與支護時序連成設計模型，反映地下工程由單一構件強度走向地層、施工時序與維護共同驗證的發展。擠壓是高應力下的時間相依變形，不能直接等同材料遇水膨脹。 1992 年 CEDD 岩洞指南初版、2009 年 FHWA 隧道土木手冊及 2018 年岩洞指南第二版提供公開閱讀脈絡。哥達與英法海底隧道僅作地質及地下水邊界的比較，本課不主張取得其專有圖說或現場數據，只重建公開原理。~The focus on link squeezing-ground convergence, yielding travel and support timing reflects the development from isolated member strength toward combined ground, sequence and maintenance verification. Squeezing is stress-driven time-dependent deformation and is not identical to water-induced swelling. The 1992 first CEDD cavern guide, 2009 FHWA civil tunnel manual and 2018 second cavern-guide edition provide public context. Gotthard and the Channel Tunnel are comparisons of geological and groundwater boundaries only. This course claims no proprietary drawings or field data and reconstructs public principles.
